Phillip Island Circuit.comment: 9 corners detected but iRacing reports 12 turns. The three missing turns are same-segment merges, confirmed from the lap-9 steering trace: detected #2 has two left apexes (+90 deg at 21.7%, unwinds to +35%, re-loads to +79 deg at 23.9%); detected #7 likewise (+66 deg at 69.1%, +48 deg at 71.9%); detected #8 reverses direction (right to -131 deg at ~76%, then left to +78 deg at 77.6-79.1%). 1+2+1+1+1+1+2+2+1 = 12, so the official numbering above is determined by position. Names are only filled in where confirmed — turns 5-12 still need reading off the in-sim map. Hockenheimring Baden-Württemberg.comment: Outer layout (4352m). 6 corners detected but iRacing reports 12 turns, so the generated T-numbers are NOT official: detected T3 is the hairpin, officially T6. Official Outer-layout numbering was not found in any reliable source - fill these in from the in-sim track map, in order from the S/F line; an empty entry keeps the generated label. Direction is from the SteeringAngle sign (negative = right; the hairpin is negative). Detected corners on the 1:50.662 lap 7 (lap %, length, shape, min speed): 1) 4.8-11.3% 283m right, apex ~6.2% then a second smaller right ~7.3% and a long gentle right to 11%, 141kph; 2) 18.1-24.5% 279m slow right (apex 19.3%, 74kph) then a brief flick and a left at 20.8-22.5% ~100-117kph, so at least two official turns; [S3 is a 966m straight with a gentle curve, 199kph]; 3) 46.7-49.4% 118m right HAIRPIN 53kph (official T6); [S4 1010m straight, 197kph]; 4) 72.6-77.7% 222m long fast right 134-144kph; 5) 80.8-87.3% 283m slow left (111 deg, 87kph) then a lighter left ~85-86% at 120kph; 6) 87.3-96.5% 400m run of rights at 109-115kph with apexes ~89%, ~90.6%, ~92.5% and ~93.5% - several official turns merged. Merges in 1, 2, 5 and 6 account for the 12-vs-6 difference. Note: the track name is published with a non-UTF-8 byte, so this key does not match until that bug is fixed.
